key_insight: A score-based reduced-order model can capture the unresolved-scale feedback in barotropic quasi-geostrophic turbulence while matching the learned stationary distribution by construction.
engineering_relevance: This enables fast, data-driven coarse models for turbulent flows when full-resolution simulation is too expensive or only coarse observations are available.
method: Learn a score-based model on coarse-grained variables from data.
Use the learned stationary distribution as the target for the reduced-order dynamics.
Calibrate dynamics to match finite-time correlations of energy across wavenumber shells.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports high-accuracy reproduction of stationary statistics for the resolved flow, with calibration that does not require forward integration of the model.
watch_item: Performance may depend on how well the training data represent the turbulence regime and on whether the chosen coarse variables retain enough information for closure.
paper_title: Score-based stochastic reduced-order models of barotropic quasi-geostrophic turbulence
